content: मण्डल {%a.%} [मण्ड्-कलच्] Round, circular; मण्डलाग्रा बृसीश्चैव गृहान्याः पृष्ठतो ययुः <ls>Rām. 5. 18. 12</ls>. .{@-लः@} .²1 circular array of troops. .²2 A dog. .²3 A kind of snake. .{@-लम्@} .²1 A circular orb, globe, wheel, ring, circumference, anything round or circular; न्यग्रोधं च सुमण्डलम् <ls>Mb. 12. 169. 12</ls>; करालफणमण्डलम् <ls>R. 12. 98</ls>; आदर्शमण्डलनिभानि समुल्लसन्ति <ls>Ki. 5. 41</ls>; स्फुरत्प्रभामण्डलया चकाशे <ls>Ku. 1. 24</ls>; so रेणुमण्डल, छायामण्डल, चापमण्डल, मुखमण्डल, स्तनमण्डल <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 The charmed circle (drawn by a conjurer); मण्डले पन्नगो रुद्धो मन्त्रैरिव महाविषः <ls>Rām. 2. 12. 5</ls>; जानन्ति तन्त्रयुक्तिं यथास्थितं मण्डलमभिलिखन्ति <ls>Mu. 2. 1</ls>. .²3 A disc, especially of the sun or moon; तेनातपत्रामलमण्डलेन <ls>R. 16. 27</ls>; अपर्वणि ग्रहकलुषेन्दुमण्डला (विभावरी) <ls>M. 4. 15</ls>; दिनमणिमण्डलमण्डन भवखण्डन ए <ls>Gīt. 1</ls>. .²4 The halo round the sun or moon. .²5 The path or orbit of a heavenly body. .²6 A multitude, group, collection, assemblage, troop, company; एवं मिलितेन कुमारमण्डलेन <ls>Dk.</ls>; अखिलं चारिमण्डलम् <ls>R. 4. 4</ls>. .²7 Society, association. .²8 A great circle. .²9 The visible horizon. .²10 A district or province. .²11 A surrounding district or territory. .²12 (In politics) The circle of a kingʼs near and distant neighbours; मण्डलचरितम् <ls>Kau. A. 1. 1. 1</ls>; सततसुकृती भूयाद् भूपः प्रसादितमण्डलः <ls>Ve. 6. 44</ls>; उपगतोऽपि च मण्डलनाभिताम् <ab>&c.</ab> <ls>R. 9. 15</ls>. (According to Kāmandaka quoted by <ls>Malli.</ls> the circle of a kingʼs near and distant neighbours consists of twelve kings:-- विजिगीषु or the central monarch, the five kings whose dominions are in the front), and the four kings whose dominions are in the rear of his kingdom, the मध्यम or intermediate, and उदासीन or indifferent king. The kings in the front as well as in the rear are designated by particular names; see <ls>Malli.</ls> {%ad loc.%}; <ab>cf.</ab> also <ls>Śi. 2. 81</ls>. and <ls>Malli.</ls> thereon. According to some the number of such kings is four, six, eight, twelve or even more; see <ls>Mit.</ls> on <ls>Y. 1. 345</ls>. According to others, the circle consists of three kings only:-- the प्राकृतारि or natural enemy, (the sovereign of an adjacent country), the प्राकृतमित्र natural ally, (the sovereign whose dominions are separated by those of another from the country of the central monarch with whom he is allied), and प्राकृतोदासीन or the natural neutral, (the sovereign whose dominions lie beyond those of the natural ally). .²13 A particular position of the feet in shooting. .²14 A kind of mystical diagram used in invoking a divinity. .²15 A division of the Ṛgveda (the whole collection being divided into .²10 Maṇḍalas or eight Aṣṭakas). .²16 A kind of leprosy with round spots. .²17 A kind of perfume. .²18 A circular bandage (in surgery). .²19 A sugar-ball, sweetmeat. .²20 Sexual dalliances; नानाविचित्रकृतमण्डलमावहन्तीम् <ls>Bil. Ch. (uttarapīṭhikā) 38</ls>. .²21 A circular gait; हय इव मण्डलमाशु यः करोति <ls>Rām. 6. 33. 35</ls>; <ls>Mb. 3. 19. 8</ls>. .²22 A play-board (द्यूते शारीस्थापनपट्टम्); <ls>Mb. 8. 74. 15</ls>. .{@-ली@} .²1 A circle, orb <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 A group, assemblage; तन्मोचनाय तेनाशु प्रेरिता शिष्यमण्डली <ls>Bm. 1. 648</ls>. .²3 Walking round, circular motion. .²4 Bent grass (दूर्वा).
